The '''Massacre on Soheras Trench''' was part of the [[Genocide on Dac|Genocide of Mon Calamari]] ordered by [[Darth Krayt]] to punish the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] people for their aid to the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. The massacre was ordered by [[Darth Azard]], a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], and served to test the abilities of the [[Sea Leviathan]], a kind of semi-sentient [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] created by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] scientist [[Vul Isen]], based on the ancient [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|Leviathans]] of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]].

The creature eliminated all prisoners of [[Imperial Extermination Camp 28]], located on [[Soheras Trench]], where the Leviathan had been kept in hibernation waiting for the order to be unleashed. Following the complete elimination of the camp's prisoners, Lord Azard and Isen sent the Sea Leviathan to [[Battle of Devil's Crevasse|hunt down]] the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]].

==Behind the scenes==
The massacre appeared in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]. Written by [[John Ostrander]] with art by [[Omar Francia]], it was the first issue of the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']] story arc of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''.
